_comment: Example character for the D&D 2024 Character JSON spec — a Human Fighter (no spells). Copy this as a starting point for your own PCs.
name: Bram Ironhold

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see Feats).

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.notes: Simple, Ammunition, Loading, Two-Handed, Slow, Range (80/320)

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.description: Once per turn, reroll the damage dice of a weapon attack and use either result. (Soldier background origin feat.)

feats.name: Alert
feats.description: Add your Proficiency Bonus to your Initiative, and you can swap Initiative with a willing ally. (Human origin feat.)

class_features.name: Fighting Style — Defense
class_features.description: +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor (already included in AC).

class_features.name: Second Wind (3/Long Rest, Bonus Action)
class_features.description: Regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. Regain a use on a Short Rest.

class_features.name: Action Surge (1/Short or Long Rest)
class_features.description: Take one extra action on your turn (not the Magic action).

class_features.name: Tactical Mind
class_features.description: On a failed ability check, expend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to the check.

class_features.name: Champion — Improved Critical
class_features.description: Your attack rolls score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

class_features.name: Champion — Remarkable Athlete
class_features.description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus to STR/DEX/CON checks; your running long jump is longer.

personality: Stands at the front and never asks an ally to take a risk he wouldn't take first.
